title: Sprint 3: Partner Pairing, Crew Logbook & Couple Capsules
goal: Build the Grand Line partner pairing system with 8-character code exchange, anniversary milestone tracking, crew contact manager, and couple-mode time capsule reveals.

issues.title: [Feature] Grand Line Partner Pairing & Pairing Code Exchange
issues.user_story: As a user, I want to generate an 8-character partner pairing code and share it with my significant other so our accounts are linked, allowing us to send direct partner letters and celebrate shared milestones.

models: server/src/models/User.js (partner ObjectId ref, partnerInviteCode sparse index)

acceptance_criteria: User can generate an 8-character alphanumeric partner invite code with copy-to-clipboard button.
Recipient user can enter invite code in their profile to link both accounts bidirectionally.
Once paired, both users' profiles display their partner's avatar, username, and paired badge.
Either user can safely unpair with a confirmation dialog.
Pairing prevents self-pairing or pairing with an already-linked account (returns clean error 400).
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] User A calls POST /api/users/partner/invite -> verify 8-character uppercase code returned.
2. [API Test] User B calls POST /api/users/partner/pair with User A's code -> verify both User A and User B show mutual partner ObjectIds.
3. [UI Test] Navigate to /profile as User A -> confirm partner status badge shows User B username and avatar.
4. [Security Test] User C attempts to pair with the same consumed code -> verify HTTP 400 'Code is invalid or already used'.
5. [Automated] Add partner pair/unpair roundtrip assertion to server/src/scripts/smoke.js.

issues.title: [Feature] Saved Crew Management & Address Book
issues.user_story: As a frequent letter writer, I want a saved 'Crew' address book in my settings so I can quickly select recurring recipients without re-typing their email addresses.
acceptance_criteria: Users can view, add, and remove crew members (name + email) from their profile/settings.
RecipientPicker in /write page features a quick dropdown selector populated with saved crew members.
When writing a letter to an external email, an 'Add to my Crew' checkbox automatically adds the contact if checked.
Duplicate emails for the same user are prevented with a friendly validation warning.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] POST /api/users/me/crew with { name: 'Zoro', email: 'zoro@sunny.sea' } -> verify entry added to user document.
2. [UI Test] Open /write -> click RecipientPicker -> verify 'Zoro (zoro@sunny.sea)' appears in dropdown and auto-populates fields on click.
3. [UI Test] Delete crew member from /profile -> verify recipient picker removes item.
4. [Automated] Test crew CRUD in server smoke tests.

issues.title: [Feature] Shared Anniversary & Couple Capsule Milestones
issues.user_story: As a paired couple, I want to set our anniversary date so the app can suggest special capsule milestones (e.g. Next Anniversary, +1 Year, +5 Years) and customize the capsule aesthetic.
acceptance_criteria: Paired users can configure their shared anniversary date.
Profile displays an animated countdown badge: 'Next Anniversary in X Days'.
Compose letter date picker adds a 1-click preset: 'On Our Next Anniversary'.
Letters sent with type 'partner' or 'us' display a special couple chest ribbon in Captain's Log.
end_to_end_test_plan: 1. [API Test] PATCH /api/users/me with anniversary date -> verify persistence in MongoDB.
2. [UI Test] Navigate to /write -> click DatePicker -> click 'On Our Next Anniversary' preset -> verify calculated target date matches next anniversary.
3. [UI Test] Check Captain's Log for partner letters -> verify couple ribbon and badge display correctly.
4. [Automated] Add anniversary date calculation assertion to test suite.
